# Runtime data flow

config.py resolves runtime paths and loader settings. ResearchLoader declares DataItem sources in Python. Relative source paths are anchored to the defining Python module, including when Optuna renders the XML elsewhere.

DataRegistry reads Memmap blocks into LoadedSource, applies the declared trading-day delay once, calls process_source, and validates [date, stock, field] results. dates/codes must be retained; fields may be derived by source processing. No raw bar axis survives processing. Source ops and declared dependencies operate on logical dates after reduction.

Processed caches use LRU eviction and are keyed by logical date and sampling time. Each cached row owns its storage; reads fill only contiguous missing ranges. Daily Memmap inputs use the array reader with cached column alignment. Live refresh invalidates current-date processed results and reopens raw readers. Raw prices are not converted to the model's low-precision dtype. With cache_path configured, the default validity contract intersects delay-1 base, no-new-stock and limit masks; an explicit model_validity_source overrides it.

ComboDataLoader concatenates explicitly selected sources into one tensor, converts infinite feature values to NaN, and applies feature preprocessing. ComboTrainDataset preloads selected-stock features per sampling time and training targets into an in-memory snapshot, using chunked feature reads and encoding directly into the supplied Codec storage. Memory scales with training dates, sampling times, stocks, and features. Each sample decodes a same-time window, applies transform_feature_window, and returns (idx, ds, ti, x, y, w) without source reads or target recomputation. With no compression, the window passed to transform_feature_window shares dataset storage; in-place changes affect subsequent overlapping samples. FP4/FP8 decoding creates a separate feature tensor. Returned targets and weights share dataset storage in all modes. Source updates require rebuilding the dataset. It reserves retDays-1 endpoint rows for default forward component aggregation; researcher target indexing is explicit.

ComboBase retains prediction-before-training scheduling, isTrainDay, checkpoint IO and model smoothing. Per-time ComboBuffer instances append new dates and refresh the current live date. Decoded windows and per-model stock selections are reused until buffer updates; window transforms run after stock selection. All prediction calls include di/ti, and all alpha keys are (date,time). runCombo passes explicitly selected execution prices to the existing backtest. DailyBacktest preserves state between intraday calls, checks T+1 at execution, accumulates turnover, and settles once at the last configured time.

runEval uses the same researcher raw target and validity hooks for IC, prefetches targets in per-time chunks, and reuses those inputs for deciles. PnL comes from actual execution daily records. Aggregate-only evaluation utilities remain available for standalone matrices.

Verification: tests/test_cube_feature_groups.py covers real Memmap reduction, delay, real-time mutation and array-model training. tests/test_backtest_snap_ti.py contains the actual-cache, actual-Torch and actual-MOSEK two-day intraday pipeline including report generation. The codec tests exercise the unchanged tensor codecs.
